description: This file defines an ApiClient class that wraps the Dio HTTP client to facilitate API calls with JWT token management, retries, and circuit breaker resilience. It provides a method to perform GET requests expecting JSON responses, with mechanisms to handle authorization headers and error handling.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: Encapsulates network request handling with JWT authentication, retries, and circuit breaker support.

methods.name: getJson
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified path, returning the response as a JSON object with retry and circuit breaker mechanisms.
